judgments.candidate_name: attrs frozen value classes with type-checked ordering
judgments.candidate_claim: A frozen class per constant family can provide same-type equality and opt-in ordinal comparison without inheriting ordinary integer arithmetic.
judgments.match_rationale: No primary match. The original application explicitly separates value classes from the registry, so a distinct class per family alone does not match G01. It supplies no metaclass and does not select primitive coupling or hidden keys.

H.reason: Frozen instances and a proposed immutable registry do not establish construction control or a closed member universe; these decisive mechanisms are explicitly left custom.
Same-type field equality distinguishes other types, but newly constructed outside-registry instances can still share the same fields. Canonicalization and membership rules remain unspecified.

H.constraint: 의미 있는 순서·비교를 제공하고 무의미한 연산 제한
H.reason: The original translation selects ordinal-only same-family ordering and does not inherit numeric arithmetic.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map frozen class fields to member name/ordinal and type checks to family comparisons; the registry supplies allowed-member order. Construction, canonicalization and closed membership must be specified before the mapped design can satisfy H1/H2.
judgments.H_assessment_scope: reference_design: Frozen value classes plus a separate immutable ordered registry, with missing construction/canonicalization retained.
judgments.label: INSUFFICIENT
judgments.remaining_check: Read a concrete proposed constructor/registry contract that rejects or canonicalizes outside-set instances; without it the family may remain open or admit equality with nonmembers.

judgments.candidate_claim: A single enum declaration generates name lookup, validation, and declaration-order iteration, offering a concrete model for keeping the named member set consistent.
judgments.match_rationale: No primary match. Single-declaration table generation does not itself choose the combined family/value class structure or a metaclass. A warning that native integral conversion is unsafe is not a proposal to adopt the primitive-coupling alternative.

H.reason: At the selected generated-table design scope, a declaration fixes the named member table and indices. Its transfer must preserve that fixed table rather than expose a mutable membership registry.

The original target use explicitly selects same-family comparisons and rejects duplicate backing values. It warns against default integral conversion instead of recommending that default as target semantics.

H.constraint: 의미 있는 순서·비교를 제공하고 무의미한 연산 제한
H.reason: Declaration indices supply order, while the original target restricts comparison to the family; the native numeric conversion is not part of the selected translation.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map generated name/member tables and indices to fixed Python factory output; use the originally specified family gate and ordinal comparisons, and reject duplicate backing values. If directly adopting C++, the documented strict-conversion setting requires C++11; no native default conversion is approved.
judgments.H_assessment_scope: reference_design: Generated member table and index lookup transferred to a Python factory with the original same-family and duplicate-rejection conditions.
judgments.label: CONDITIONAL_TRANSFER
judgments.remaining_check: Specify the target table/freezing and lookup construction paths before implementation approval, preserving the stated family gate and duplicate rejection. Do not reinterpret this reference pass as evidence that unconfigured C++ defaults meet isolation.

judgments.candidate_name: Magic Enum metadata sequences and optional operators
judgments.candidate_claim: Separate value/name sequences and checked lookup APIs show how traversal and identification can be exposed independently of optional flag operators.
judgments.match_rationale: No primary match. Explicit metadata and deliberate conversions are not strong ordinary-primitive identity; the fixed gold itself permits names and indices. No single-class or metaclass choice is made.

H.reason: The original response explicitly leaves the closed Python member universe to further design; immutable metadata alone does not settle it.
Alias collapse and membership/conversion policy are unresolved for the target symbolic values. Checked metadata lookup does not by itself define distinct canonical members.

H.constraint: 의미 있는 순서·비교를 제공하고 무의미한 연산 제한
H.reason: The response explicitly leaves the target order policy to design. Separating optional flag operators is useful but does not supply the required meaningful ordering.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map metadata sequences to traversal and checked lookup to identification, keeping flag-only operators separate. A target order, alias policy and closed-member construction are required connections not supplied by the original response.
judgments.H_assessment_scope: reference_design: Metadata/lookup API separation, with target membership and order policies explicitly unresolved.
judgments.label: INSUFFICIENT
judgments.remaining_check: Read the proposed target order, alias and constructor policies. Their definitions can resolve H1-H3; no runtime measurement is needed merely to settle those missing design premises.
